title: Plagiarism Checker Turnitin Investigating Cyberattack
description: Turnitin, an education technology company providing plagiarism checking services, disclosed a cyberattack involving certain customer-facing systems. The company states that its systems remain fully operational and safe to use, and that no government ID or financial information is collected by the affected systems. Turnitin is investigating the incident with external experts and has notified authorities. The exact nature, scope, and impact of the breach, including whether any data was accessed or which systems were compromised, have not been disclosed. The University of Colorado Boulder, a customer, reported no indication of data exposure and has increased monitoring of related integrations. The investigation is ongoing.
